 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Before starting any work on the machine, check that it is switched off and 
 blocked up for switching on again.

sections.text: Changing the Bearings (A)

Removal of Bearings 
Shell 
(A1)
Remove the split guard (drive end only)

Loosen bearing assembly bolts, upper with lower section and upper section with 
 bearing bracket
Remove cover of bearing housing
Loosen bearing shell bolts
Remove top bearing shell
Open lubricating oil ring joint and pull out ring
رفع العمود باستخدام جهاز الرفع
Twist bottom bearing shell free and remove

items: Remove the split guard (drive end only)

Loosen bearing assembly bolts, upper with lower section and upper section with 
 bearing bracket
Remove cover of bearing housing
Loosen bearing shell bolts
Remove top bearing shell
Open lubricating oil ring joint and pull out ring
رفع العمود باستخدام جهاز الرفع
Twist bottom bearing shell free and remove

sections.text: Bearing Shell Installation (A2)

The installation of bearing shell is done in reverse order to the sequence of 
 removal described in 
 (A1).

By assembling it, care should be taken not to damage the bearing ring seals 
 (half rings). They should be checked before installation and replaced if 
 necessary.

sections.text: Disassembly - Assembly (B)

Disassembly of Motor Uncoupled 
(B1)
Drain bearing oil on both sides
Remove the bearing shell at the drive end as per (A1 without point 1)
Disconnect and remove bearing thermometer on both sides

Loosen the bolts in the lower section of the bearing housing jointed to the 
 bearing bracket and remove the lower section of the bearing housing

Insert a sheet 0.5 mm thick between the bearing bracket ring seal and the 
 shaft and carefully lower the rotor
Remove the bearing shell at the non-drive-end as per (A1)
Proceed as per (B1 point 4)

Unscrew and remove side covers of stator housing and dismantle piping of 
 pressurized sealing chamber
Loosen bearing bracket dowel pins and withdraw them

Loosen bearing bracket bolts and press the bearing bracket off the stator 
 housing using 2 bearing bracket bolts via the two threaded holes

Carefully lower the rotor together with the bearing bracket into the stator 
 bore
Remove bearing bracket
Lift rotor on the drive end side
Proceed as per (B1point 9, 10, 11 and 12)
Dismantle air guides

Lift rotor on both ends and carefully remove it from the stator. Take 
 particular care for the stator winding when rotor is handled
